September 25th, 2026

Search for ghosts in Rock Island at 7 p.m. Saturday at 500 20th St.!

Every year, paranormal investigators and enthusiasts across the country come together to celebrate one thing…
The search for the unknown.

This September, join C&R Paranormal at the Rock Island Roadhouse as we celebrate National Ghost Hunting Day with a special night of live paranormal investigation inside one of the Quad Cities’ most talked about haunted locations.

Whether you’re a longtime investigator, a curious skeptic, or someone attending their very first ghost hunt, this event is designed to bring people together for a night dedicated to paranormal exploration, shared experiences, and the thrill of investigating the unexplained.

Explore the haunted Rock Island Roadhouse after dark
Use real paranormal investigation equipment
Participate in live interactive investigation sessions
Investigate alongside the C&R Paranormal team
All experience levels welcome

From reported voices and shadow figures to unexplained activity experienced by past guests, the Roadhouse continues to leave people questioning what may still remain inside its walls.

On National Ghost Hunting Day… there’s no better place to investigate.

Rock Island Roadhouse
Saturday, September 26, 2026
Doors Open: 6:30 PM
Limited spots available

Reserve yours before they disappear.

Sean Leary is an author, director, artist, musician, producer and entrepreneur who has been writing professionally since debuting at age 11 in the pages of the Comics Buyers Guide. An honors graduate of the University of Southern California masters program, he has written over 50 books including the best-sellers The Arimathean, Every Number is Lucky to Someone and We Are All Characters.
